name: Bus station (abandoned)
description: Abandoned and overgrown: Town bus station, 23 x 27 m: a tall glazed single-storey hall with a deep steel entrance canopy and blank sign panels; behind it a 5.5 m platform under a cantilevered canopy with four bus bays, a 7.5 m bus road and an island platform with a butterfly canopy, glass wind screens and bay posts; fixed metal benches throughout. Enterable: the waiting hall with fixed bench rows and a departure board, the ticket office behind a glazed ticket window with a counter, and restrooms; doors out to the platform.
